front: TC099: What is the minimum viable move?
back: I have a win to share: [specific win]. I am pleased about it.

front: TC099: What is the core sequence?
back: Permission or context + clean win + honest feeling + proportionate context + release. -> Can I share a win? I got the fellowship. I am really pleased because it was a long process. -> Good news: the launch landed well. I am proud of the team and relieved the preparation paid off. -> I got invited to speak at the conference. I am excited and a little nervous. -> The client renewed. I am glad the work created enough trust to continue..

front: TC099: What is the field tip?
back: Do not smuggle a win in as a problem.

front: TC099: What is the strong version of: Ugh, now I have to deal with all these congrats messages.?
back: I got promoted. I am pleased and still adjusting to the attention. Thanks for letting me share it.

front: TC099: What is the strong version of: Apparently my presentation was amazing and now everyone wants the deck.?
back: The presentation landed well. I am glad it helped, and I am sending the deck round for anyone who wants it.

front: TC099: What is the strong version of: I hate being too booked because people keep asking me to lead things.?
back: I am getting more requests lately. I am grateful for the trust, and I need to be selective with my time.

front: TC099: What is better than: It is so annoying that everyone keeps asking me to speak.?
back: I have been asked to speak a fair bit lately. I am pleased people want to hear it.

front: TC099: What is better than: The award is probably nothing, honestly.?
back: The award means a lot to me, and I wanted to share it.

front: TC099: What is better than: Apparently I was the only one who actually understood it.?
back: The work landed well, and I am proud of how it turned out.

front: TC099: What are signs it is working?
back: They ask concrete follow-up questions about how it happened. They smile or offer natural congratulations. They link the news to your effort or the backstory. They volunteer related curiosity without looking cornered. The share feels like information, not a request for admiration. The sentence would still be fine if they had said nothing back.

front: TC099: When should you avoid this technique?
back: Someone else is currently sharing vulnerable news or their own win The win is irrelevant to the relationship or the situation

front: TC099: What is the best recovery line?
back: That came out more self-congratulatory than I meant. Cleaner version: I am happy about it.
